input_fields.name: screen_region
input_fields.description: One viewport rectangle with start/end screen coordinates.

input_fields.name: box_direction
input_fields.description: left_to_right for fully enclosed objects or right_to_left for touched objects.

input_fields.name: selection_filter
input_fields.description: Object type/filter active during the box selection.

result_fields.name: box_selection_set
result_fields.description: Selected identities, direction, filter, and observed enclosure/intersection rule.

procedure: Set selection_filter and confirm screen_region does not include unintended panels.
Drag one box in the declared direction; use left-to-right for fully enclosed or right-to-left for touched candidates.
Observe selected identities and return box_selection_set.
Do not add Ctrl/Shift modifiers unless a separate calibrated toggle/add action is explicitly requested.
rejection_rules: Reject invalid/ambiguous region, unknown direction semantics, or a box crossing a blocking dialog.
Do not infer membership from pixel overlap without observing the selection set.
Do not combine box select with subsequent toggles.
